mechanism: 单一路线失败推广为全局禁止

original.excerpt: 任何 Q=0 证明必须全局控制熵和,不能逐因子分解
original.context: Translation: “Any Q=0 proof must control the entropy sum globally and cannot decompose factor by factor.” Failure of a bracketwise proof for the selected channel pair was generalized into a universal prohibition.

witness.explanation: A self-complementary channel gives a counterexample to the universal bracketwise no-go.
witness.evidence: For the 50% erasure channel A_(1/2), receiver and environment channels are unitarily equivalent. For A_(1/2) tensor A_(1/2), the corresponding receiver/environment conditional-entropy brackets match individually and each difference is zero. Their sum therefore proves coherent information zero by a legitimate per-bracket argument. Failure of a bracket bound for the originally selected pair cannot rule out this case.

adjudication.rationale_zh: 50% 擦除信道的接收端与环境等价，逐括号相减可以各自为零。特定信道对的逐项策略失败，不支持“任何 Q=0 证明都不能如此”的排他结论。
